title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXIII OF 2017
ACT XXXIII OF 2017
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PUBLIC SERVICE
COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
3rd November, 2017]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills / 2017 / 10951, dated 3.11.2017.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission
(Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 24th October, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 31st October, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission (Amendment)
Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from
October 23, 2017.

Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 4 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978), in
section 4, in subsection (1),-
(a) for
the word "three", the word "five" shall be substituted; and
(b) the
full stop appearing at the end of subsection (1) shall be replaced by a colon
and thereafter the following proviso shall be added, namely:
"Provided
that the condition of holding office for a term of five (5) years shall also be
applicable on existing members appointed before the commencement of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2017, and holding post
as such on October 23, 2017, irrespective their order of appointment made
earlier.".
